business_problem: 3D AI Studio needed a production-grade foundation for highly elastic generative 3D workloads so demand spikes and long generation times would not undermine reliability, user trust, or its planned expansion from B2C SaaS into enterprise markets.
solution_summary: 3D AI Studio moved its generative 3D workload onto Tencent Cloud as the core infrastructure layer for text-to-3D and image-to-3D asset creation. User requests from the SaaS platform enter a production-grade environment on Tencent Cloud, where elastic compute capacity absorbs unpredictable demand spikes and runs the generation pipeline that turns concepts into textured, export-ready 3D assets. Rather than maintaining its own heavy hardware stack, the company uses Tencent Cloud's stable AI infrastructure to support global expansion and enterprise-grade service levels. The operating model is reinforced by direct collaboration with Tencent Cloud's engineering team, which helps the company resolve infrastructure issues quickly as it moves from pilot phases into full production. By treating Tencent Cloud as both the runtime substrate and scaling partner, 3D AI Studio can pursue B2B growth while keeping latency, reliability, and operational debt under control.

solution_components.name: Tencent Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides the elastic AI infrastructure and high-performance compute foundation that runs 3D generation workloads and supports global scaling.

data_flow: Artists submit text prompts or images to 3D AI Studio's SaaS platform, where the generative 3D pipeline runs on Tencent Cloud's elastic infrastructure and returns textured, export-ready 3D assets to creators and enterprise production teams.
business_outcome: The partnership let 3D AI Studio cut generation latency, scale rapidly after late 2025, and support creators and enterprise customers without carrying the cost and complexity of a proprietary heavy-infrastructure stack.

evidence_quotes: 3D AI Studio is a pioneering technology company at the intersection of generative AI and 3D design.

Trusted by over one million artists worldwide, the platform provides a comprehensive suite of tools that enable designers to move from concept to a textured, export-ready 3D asset in just a few minutes.

By leveraging Tencent Cloud's high-performance computing power, 3D AI Studio successfully reduced its 3D generation time from a seven-minute bottleneck to a highly competitive three-to-five-minute window.
The elasticity of Tencent Cloud's power ensures that 3D AI Studio can expand its boundaries without the technical debt of maintaining heavy internal hardware.
